chunks: And with this chain of transmission, he said:

The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم ruled concerning one who stole fruits in his sleeve: whatever he ate from it, then there is nothing upon him; and whatever he carried away, he is to be given ta'zir and made to pay its value twice.

key_terms.الثِّمَارَ: fruits taken as the subject of theft
key_terms.فَلَا شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ: no penalty is upon him for that part
key_terms.فَيُعَزَّرُ: he is subjected to discretionary punishment (ta'zir)
key_terms.فِي كُمِّهِ: in his sleeve, meaning concealed in his garment
key_terms.قَضَى: issued a legal ruling or judgment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone steals fruit and eats some of it or carries it away?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم regarding theft of fruit. It distinguishes between what is immediately eaten and what is carried away, assigning ta'zir and double compensation for the latter.
